story_type: lava fountains erupting inside a neighborhood, Guard escort
hook: Lava fountains, erupting at the end of a neighborhood street.
narration: Those are fountains of lava, erupting at the end of a neighborhood street.
This was Leilani Estates, on Hawaii's Big Island, in May 2018.
The Kilauea eruption was tearing the ground open here, with new fissures opening each day.
A wall of fresh black rock had already swallowed the road.
The Hawaii National Guard escorted a group of reporters in to see two of the active fissures.
The worst danger was invisible. Fissures pour out sulfur dioxide, a toxic gas, so Guard teams measured it around the clock.
After dark, the glow lit up the whole sky.
[short pause] And every burst flung glowing rock into the night air.
outcome: By nightfall, the fissures were still roaring at the end of the street.
title: Lava fountains at the end of the street
description:
During the 2018 Kilauea eruption, the Hawaii National Guard escorted media into Leilani Estates on Hawaii's Big Island to see active fissures and lava flows inside the neighborhood.
